# Owned synthetic Stage 01 fixtures

Generate with `python3 generate.py` (Pillow with OpenJPEG) or `make fixtures`.
All PDFs are created from mathematical patterns and fixed ASCII text; they
contain no copied documents, credentials or personal data. They may be used
and distributed with this project. No external fixture license is required.

The image is placed in a 144 × 144 point square on a 216 × 216 point page:
1200 × 1200 pixels means 600 dpi, 300 × 300 means 150 dpi. Each document also
contains Helvetica text, a URI link to example.org and a bookmark to its page.
`manifest.json` records positive filter/BPC/dimensions and exact PDF SHA-256.

The JBIG2 positive fixture embeds synthetic page-information and an immediate
MMR generic region, generated losslessly by Pillow's TIFF Group4 encoder. Its
pixel matrix is the same as the mono Flate fixture. This is a real decoder
fixture but does not cover JBIG2 symbol dictionaries or global segments.
JPX is a lossless RGB JPEG2000 stream generated by Pillow/OpenJPEG.

`generate.py` is QA fixture generation only. No production Go resizer, codec,
PDF lexer or JSON update generator is introduced. Different Pillow versions
may produce different encoded bytes; saved source fixtures and their manifest
are the source of truth for reproducible probes.

Stage 07 adds `generate_quality.py` and `quality-manifest.json` (32 SHA-256 rows).
Run the generator with the bundled Python containing Pillow/reportlab/pypdf.
It preserves the original Stage 01 fixtures. New raw PDF operators, bitmaps,
ASCII/Cyrillic/OCR text, QR payload `STAGE07-QUALITY-2026` and Code128 payload
`STAGE07-128` are synthetic and project-owned. Embedded font: DejaVu Sans from
`/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf`; the Bitstream Vera/DejaVu license
allows redistribution of the subset. See `/usr/share/doc/fonts-dejavu-core/copyright`
on the generating host, and `dejavu-font-license.txt` saved here. No full font copied.
Generated ICC data comes from Pillow/lcms built-in sRGB profile; no external document.

Coverage includes CCITT/JBIG2 MMR, JPX, JPEG, Flate/PNG predictor, Indexed, LZW,
RunLength, embedded/unembedded fonts, invisible OCR, vectors/6pt text, QR/Code128,
SMask/Mask, inline images, nested Forms, shared placements with rotation/mirroring,
UserUnit/CropBox, URI/GoTo/bookmarks and special-type refusal fixtures. JBIG2 symbol
and global-segment variants remain outside the bounded fixture coverage.
Load fixtures live under `artifacts/stage-07/load-fixtures` and are generated from
seeded patterns: 500/501 pages, exactly 50 MiB / 500 pages, and 64 distinct image
objects with duplicate or unique pixels. No personal data is used.
